sources.author: OpenStax
sources.title: Calculus Volume 3 4.3 Partial Derivatives
sections_checked: Definition of partial derivative with other independent variables fixed
conditions_applied: Fixed data are separate from differentiable parameters.
A partial derivative at a point is a scalar, not the full multivariable gradient.

sources.author: OpenStax
sources.title: Calculus Volume 3 4.4 Tangent Planes and Linear Approximations
sections_checked: Differentiability defined by remainder divided by displacement norm
Theorem 4.7 continuous partials as sufficient condition
conditions_applied: Partial derivatives existing at a point alone are insufficient.
Neighborhood existence and continuity hypotheses are retained.
The original model is independently proved differentiable by a uniform remainder bound.

sources.author: OpenStax
sources.title: Calculus Volume 3 4.5 The Chain Rule
conditions_applied: Inner and outer differentiability and local composability are explicit.
All paths contribute through a sum of local derivative products.
The proof handles zero intermediate increments without division by zero.

sources.author: OpenStax
sources.title: Calculus Volume 3 4.6 Directional Derivatives and the Gradient
sections_checked: Directional derivative using a unit vector
Differentiability condition for the gradient-dot-direction formula
conditions_applied: Unit direction is required for per-unit-distance comparisons.
Nonunit path speed is a distinct rate, not silently normalized.
Steepest change uses a specified Euclidean coordinate scale.

sources.author: Bjorn Poonen
sources.title: MIT 18.02 Lecture Notes Fall 2021
sections_checked: Sections 8.4 and 8.5; PDF pages 41-43: total derivative shape and linear approximation
Section 10.2; PDF pages 56-57: multivariable chain order
conditions_applied: Rows correspond to outputs, columns to input coordinates.
A scalar derivative is a row linear map; the lesson chooses a column gradient, its transpose.
The outer Jacobian is evaluated at the inner output.

sources.author: NumPy Developers
sources.title: NumPy 2.3 numpy.matmul
sections_checked: Notes on 1D promotion and 2D matrix products
conditions_applied: One-dimensional arrays do not gain a column axis from .T.
Explicit column tests distinguish (2,) and (2,1).
Contract rejects mismatched target shapes before broadcasting.

sources.author: NumPy Developers
sources.title: NumPy 2.3 numpy.allclose
conditions_applied: Explicit absolute and relative tolerances replace default assumptions.
Shape checks precede tolerance checks.
Passing allclose does not by itself verify shape or differentiability.

originality.text: Original connected Chinese exposition and derivations; no textbook examples or paragraphs copied.
originality.figures: 12 original program-generated teaching figures tied to the same two-parameter model.
originality.data: Three original deterministic dimensionless observations; no external dataset or image.

proof_scope: Direct partial-derivative derivations and a uniform multivariable remainder bound for the main model
General chain rule proved using linear maps and small remainder estimates
Continuous-partial sufficient condition stated with its hypotheses
Counterexample proves partial and even all directional derivative existence does not imply total differentiability
Finite deterministic tests validate implementation, not universal claims
interface_policy: Numerical wrappers deliberately reject boolean/string/complex/object inputs before float conversion, require finite nonempty fixed shapes, and reject invalid or unresolvable differences. CSV parsing is an explicit text-to-number boundary.
